description: This file defines models and a fetcher class for Tradier options chains, including query parameters, data transformation, and data fetching logic with API interaction.

classes.name: TradierOptionsChainsQueryParams
classes.description: Model for Tradier options chains query parameters, extending generic options chain query parameters.

classes.name: TradierOptionsChainsData
classes.description: Model for Tradier options chains data, extending generic options chain data with additional fields and aliases.

classes.name: TradierOptionsChainsFetcher
classes.description: Fetcher class for Tradier options chains, including methods to transform query parameters, fetch data asynchronously from Tradier API, and transform raw data into structured models.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Transforms a dictionary of parameters into a TradierOptionsChainsQueryParams instance.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches options chain data from Tradier API, handling API key, sandbox mode, expiration dates, and data processing.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw API data into a TradierOptionsChainsData model, including date parsing and exchange mapping.
